rules.exposure: All five reports were selected or exposed before this application. No independent holdout.
rules.identity: Exact T0226 and phase-3 origin-row joins; source-defined Gibeon and Nasbeh comparanda remain outside the scored regional roster.
rules.phase: Cutting, use, fill, repair, blocking and excavation reach remain distinct. An undated usable configuration stays UNKNOWN.
rules.direction: The reported-side-as-face model is an explicit inference. A side-position, west jamb or north label does not supply a surveyed entrance bearing.
rules.count: Counts apply to the exact listed group; the interrupted or selected coverage cannot disprove an unlocated other set. Two locus labels can name one cut.
rules.proxy: F2x retains the frozen broad porch/column proxy. It does not establish an under-pillar target, named tomb or joint cistern.
rules.geometry: Preserve the prior Arnona disabled coordinates and Mordot enclosing report-range uncertainty. No point from a schematic plan or deposit datum.
rules.decision: FAIL rejects only the specified witness/model. UNKNOWN remains a terminal not-identifiable result for the full comparison. No regional rescore or formal outcome count from this selected reading.
